name: sindre-ai-agents
description: Installation-token identity for sindre-ai's unattended agents (github, github_approver, github-sindre-ai, github-vaerksted-ai). Each MCP tool call mints a fresh ~1h installation token; per-request scope narrowing is added by follow-up work. Distinct from the customer-facing sindre-maskin App (apps/dev/src/lib/integrations/providers/github/auth.ts) — different revocation surface, different keys.
